newsitem.title: USA: Data Processing files 2.2 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: Data Processing files 2.2 mln share offer.

text.p: Data Processing Resources Corp said Tuesday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up 2.2 million common shares.
Two million shares will be offered by the company and 200,000 will be sold by Mary Ellen Weaver, chairman of the board and chief executive officer, the company said in the filing.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 9,792,321.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option on up to 280,000 additional shares, and Weaver has offered the underwriters 50,000 additional shares with the same terms.
The offering will be made through Montgomery Securities, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc and Lehman Brothers, the filing said.
Proceeds will be used to repay outstanding debt, for future acquisitions, for opening of new offices, for working capital, and for other general corporate purposes, Data said.
The Newport Beach, Calif., company provides information technology staffing services to a diverse group of corporate clients.
